board.name: PrepInMinutes Master Task Plan
board.description: Full lifecycle tracking of PrepInMinutes full-stack implementation across 8 architectural phases.

phases.name: Phase 1: Persistence Foundation
phases.description: Neon PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, and pgvector extension setup.

phases.name: Phase 2: Server Infrastructure Clients
phases.description: Prisma singleton, Upstash Redis, Cloudflare R2, and Gemini AI SDK.

phases.name: Phase 3: Deterministic Domain Core
phases.description: Mathematical scoring, Bayesian readiness, and SuperMemo-2 algorithms.

phases.name: Phase 4: Edge Security & Middleware
phases.description: Clerk route guards, Upstash rate limiting, and idempotency interceptor.

phases.name: Phase 5: Onboarding & Vector Pipeline
phases.description: Candidate profiles, resume chunking, and personalized prep roadmap synthesis.

phases.name: Phase 6: Session & Evaluation APIs
phases.description: Practice submission, mock interview evaluation, and revision sync APIs.

phases.name: Phase 7: Real-Time Voice Gateway
phases.description: Deepgram STT, Cartesia TTS, and barge-in interruption controller.

phases.name: Phase 8: Frontend-Backend Integration
phases.description: Connecting 43 static routes with live APIs and end-to-end verification.

tasks.title: Database Schema Design (prisma/schema.prisma)
tasks.scope: Author the full production schema in prisma/schema.prisma with Neon dual connection (DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL), pgvector(1536) extension, and 15 relational models covering: (1) User, CandidateProfile, PreparationPlan, (2) Knowledge Graph: CurriculumDomain, CurriculumCategory, CurriculumTopic, CurriculumQuestion, TopicEmbedding, (3) Candidate Understanding: CandidateTopicMastery (cognitive stages, SM-2 decay timestamps, rubric running averages), and (4) Multimodal Sessions: PracticeSession, MockInterviewSession, EvaluationReport, RubricScore, RevisionItem, DocumentEmbedding.
tasks.clearance: Passes `npx prisma validate` cleanly with 0 errors. References docs/architecture/layers/06-persistence-storage-layer.md.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Schema audit against docs/architecture/layers/06-persistence-storage-layer.md (15 models + pgvector)

tasks.title: Dual Connection Configuration & Prisma Adapters
tasks.scope: Configure Neon pooled connection (DATABASE_URL) with @prisma/adapter-neon and direct connection (DIRECT_URL) for advisory lock migration safety.
tasks.clearance: Database connection smoke test returns live timestamp from Neon.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Neon pooled vs direct compute connection switching verified via live timestamp query

tasks.title: Database Migration Push to Neon PostgreSQL
tasks.scope: Execute `npx prisma db push` to synchronize 10 tables and vector extension with live Neon cloud instance.
tasks.clearance: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = public; verifies all 10 tables.

requiredProcesses.staticValidation: PostgreSQL pgvector extension loaded in catalog
requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Neon public schema table verification (15 tables present)

tasks.title: Curriculum Catalog Seeding (prisma/seed.ts)
tasks.scope: Seed 135+ topics across System Design (40+), Algorithms (50+), Behavioral (20+), and Cloud (25+).
tasks.clearance: `npx prisma db seed` inserts >135 records without constraint errors.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Seed script populates >135 topics across 4 domains without foreign key constraint errors

tasks.title: Prisma Client Singleton with Tenant Isolation
tasks.scope: Build withCandidateContext(clerkUserId) helper ensuring all queries are tenant-scoped.
tasks.clearance: Queries from Tenant A cannot access records from Tenant B.

requiredProcesses.staticValidation: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Tenant isolation wrapper: Tenant A queries strictly blocked from Tenant B data

tasks.title: Upstash Redis Client Singleton
tasks.scope: Centralized REST client with automatic retry and rate-limiting wrapper.
tasks.clearance: `redis.ping()` returns PONG in <50ms.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Upstash Redis REST ping roundtrip <50ms with automatic retry logic

tasks.title: Cloudflare R2 Object Storage S3 Client
tasks.scope: Presigned URL generator and multipart upload handler for whiteboard PNGs and audio.
tasks.clearance: Successfully generates presigned PUT URLs for whiteboard PNG uploads.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Presigned PUT URL generated for Cloudflare R2; test 1-byte buffer uploaded and verified

tasks.title: Google Gemini SDK Singleton
tasks.scope: Client wrapper for gemini-2.0-flash / gemini-3.1-flash-lite and text-embedding-004.
tasks.clearance: Returns typed JSON without Markdown formatting tags.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash returns structured JSON conforming to schema without markdown backticks

tasks.title: 5-Dimension Rubric Scoring Engine
tasks.scope: Pure mathematical calculation of 0–100 overall score using weighted harmonic mean.
tasks.clearance: 100% unit test assertions pass across boundary conditions.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: 100% boundary assertions for 5-dimension rubric scoring; harmonic mean and verdict boundaries verified

tasks.title: Bayesian Candidate Readiness Engine
tasks.scope: Prior readiness score updated via Bayesian evidence weighting per completed session.
tasks.clearance: Mathematical assertions verify convergence stability without unbounded drifts.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Bayesian readiness momentum: cold-start alpha (0.40) vs converged alpha (0.15) verified over 20 iterations

tasks.title: SuperMemo-2 Spaced Repetition Engine
tasks.scope: Calculates next review intervals and ease factor decay based on candidate grade.
tasks.clearance: Unit tests assert EF floor (1.30) and future UTC review timestamps.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: SuperMemo-2 interval decay: EF floor (1.30) and future UTC nextReviewDate timestamps verified

tasks.title: Clerk Edge Authentication Route Guard
tasks.scope: Sub-10ms edge middleware enforcing authentication on private routes.
tasks.clearance: Unauthenticated calls to protected routes receive 401 Unauthorized or redirect to sign-in.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Edge middleware route guard: public routes bypass, protected routes enforce Clerk token in <10ms

tasks.title: Upstash Sliding Window Rate Limiter
tasks.scope: Sliding window rate limits: 60 req/min general, 10 req/min heavy LLM endpoints.
tasks.clearance: Exceeding threshold returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Sliding window rate limiter: trips at 60 req/min general and 10 req/min AI endpoints with Retry-After header

tasks.title: Idempotency Key Interceptor
tasks.scope: Prevent duplicate LLM calls on double clicks using Redis key idempotency:{sessionId}:{attempt} with 24h TTL.
tasks.clearance: Repeated submission within TTL returns cached result in <10ms.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Submission idempotency: repeated request within 24h short-circuits LLM call in <10ms

tasks.title: Candidate Profile API (/api/onboarding/profile)
tasks.scope: Save target role, seniority level, target companies, and weekly goal hours.
tasks.clearance: POST /api/onboarding/profile persists record and returns 201 Created.

requiredProcesses.staticValidation: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
requiredProcesses.featureValidation: POST /api/onboarding/profile validates payload via Zod, saves to Neon DB, returns 201 Created

tasks.title: Resume PDF Parser & 1536-dim Embedding Pipeline
tasks.scope: Parse resume PDF, chunk text into 500-word segments, compute 1536-dim embeddings via Gemini, and insert into DocumentEmbedding.
tasks.clearance: Cosine distance lookup retrieves relevant chunks matching sample job requirements.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: Resume PDF parser chunks text into 500-word segments and inserts 1536-dim vector into pgvector

tasks.title: Personalized Prep Roadmap Synthesis API
tasks.scope: Synthesize adaptive multi-week syllabus mapped to target timeline and weak areas.
tasks.clearance: Returns valid JSON matching PreparationPlan schema with accurate week distribution.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: POST /api/plan/generate synthesizes personalized multi-week syllabus matching domain weighting rules

tasks.title: Practice Session Submit & Evaluate API
tasks.scope: Evaluate code or whiteboard submission, generate structured EvaluationReport, save RubricScores, and update candidate readiness.
tasks.clearance: Returns 200 OK with valid EvaluationReport JSON and updated readinessDelta.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: POST /api/practice/session/submit generates EvaluationReport, updates CandidateTopicMastery, returns readinessDelta

tasks.title: Mock Interview Session End & Grading API

tasks.clearance: Evaluation report maps correctly to mock interview session with verified hiring verdict.

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: POST /api/mock-interview/session/end ingests multi-turn transcript, computes 6 rubric scores, outputs hiring verdict

tasks.title: Evaluation Report Retrieval API

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: GET /api/evaluation/[reportId] returns tenant-scoped report; strictly returns 403 Forbidden for unauthorized user

tasks.title: Revision Queue Synchronization API

requiredProcesses.featureValidation: GET /api/revision/items returns overdue items (nextReviewDate <= NOW()); POST recalculates intervals
